The '''father''' of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sagoro Autem]] was a member of a [[Autem family|family]] in which duty, honor, and loyalty to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] were deeply ingrained. Like his [[Sagoro Autem's grandfather|father]] before him, he was a [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], protecting the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|legislators]]. His son would later follow in his footsteps.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|sagoroautem|Autem, Sagoro}}</ref>
